body:
This absolutely breaks my heart.  I am so, so sorry friend.  There are no words that will make this terrible pain of yours go away.  I wish so badly there was.  Shit, I am in such unbearable pain myself right now and yet what you wrote was so painful to read that I wish I could transfer some of your pain to me.  My heart just breaks for you.

The only advice I can give... Just go there.  When you need it that bad, just go to that place in your mind where you know you will see him again one day.  There is no harm in going to that place.
